papers.title: Process Optimization and Microstructural Evolution of TC4 Alloy with YH2 Addition Fabricated by PBF-LB
papers.abstract: A three-factor, four-level orthogonal design was employed to optimize the overall forming quality of powder bed fusion with a laser beam (PBF-LB)-fabricated TC4 alloy containing 0.3 wt.% YH2. Sixteen process-parameter combinations were established, and two specimens were fabricated for each combination. Laser power, scanning speed, and hatch spacing were selected as the investigated variables. Relative density, surface roughness, and Vickers hardness were evaluated using the entropy weight method combined with the weighted-sum method. On this basis, the microstructure of the specimens produced under the optimal process parameters was systematically characterized. The results showed that the influence of the investigated factors on overall forming quality followed the order: hatch spacing > laser power > scanning speed. The optimal process parameters were a laser power of 200 W, a scanning speed of 1100 mm/s, and a hatch spacing of 0.10 mm, under which the specimens exhibited superior overall forming quality. The addition of 0.3 wt.% YH2 did not significantly alter the dominant phase constitution of the alloy, but promoted α′ martensite refinement and weakened the texture through the in situ formation of Y2O3 nano-oxide particles.

llm.relevance_to_user: 论文涉及TC4合金的工艺优化与微观结构，但缺少拉伸、疲劳等力学性能表征，对直接评估Ti-6Al-4V力学疲劳性能参考价值低。
llm.why_not_core: No tensile, fatigue, or any mechanical/fatigue characterization beyond Vickers hardness; the paper focuses on process optimization and microstructural evolution with YH2 addition, not on mechanical/fatigue performance.

summary_zh.motivation: 优化含YH2的TC4合金激光粉末床熔融工艺参数，提升成形质量。
summary_zh.method: 三因素四水平正交实验，结合熵权法和加权和法评估相对密度、表面粗糙度与硬度。
summary_zh.result: 最佳参数为激光功率200W、扫描速度1100mm/s、扫描间距0.10mm，添加YH2细化α′马氏体并弱化织构。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验制备与表征验证最优参数下的微观结构与力学性能（硬度）。

summary_en.motivation: To optimize the powder bed fusion with a laser beam (PBF-LB) process for TC4 alloy containing 0.3 wt.% YH2 to improve overall forming quality.
summary_en.method: A three-factor four-level orthogonal design was employed, and relative density, surface roughness, and Vickers hardness were evaluated using the entropy weight method combined with the weighted-sum method.
summary_en.result: The optimal parameters (200 W, 1100 mm/s, 0.10 mm) yielded superior forming quality; YH2 addition refined α′ martensite and weakened texture via in-situ Y2O3 nanoparticles.
summary_en.validation: Experimental characterization of density, roughness, hardness, and microstructure confirmed the process optimization outcomes.
